title: Folder Encrypter & Vault Archiver Pro (CustomTkinter & Python 3.10+)
overview: A zero-knowledge, military-grade folder encryption and vault archiving workstation engineered with CustomTkinter & Python 3.10+ (PyInstaller .exe Bundle). Combines Argon2id memory-hard key derivation, hardware-accelerated AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, file header obfuscation, chunked memory-bounded vault streaming, multi-pass DoD 5220.22-M source file shredding, and sub-100ms Fast sub-second application launch with a tiny ~25MB memory footprint.
key_features: Argon2id Key Derivation & AES-256-GCM Engine: High-security key derivation with configurable memory/time parameters, generating 256-bit keys for authenticated AES-GCM chunked stream encryption
Header Obfuscation & Vault Anonymization: Prepend pseudo-random entropy headers to encrypted vaults to prevent file-signature detection and magic byte analysis by forensic tools
Multi-Pass Secure Source Shredder: Optional post-encryption source file destruction executing 3-pass DoD 5220.22-M or Gutmann overwrite wipes before unlinking filesystem descriptors
Zero-Knowledge Memory Safety: Automatic passphrase memory zeroing using Rust zeroize traits, guaranteeing cryptographic keys and sensitive buffers never linger in RAM or swap space
Interactive Vault Workspace & File Tree: Drag-and-drop vault builder with item file-size breakdown, dynamic entropy gauge, strength analyzer, and vault inspection drawer
Real-Time Telemetry & Throughput Meters: Sub-millisecond IPC progress streaming featuring active MB/s throughput, elapsed/ETA timers, processed byte counters, and chunk hash validation

typography.font_family: Inter, Segoe UI, Cascadia Code, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-Controller (MVC) with Asynchronous Thread-Safe Event Queue
system_architecture.backend_rust_core: Tokio async event loop driving memory-bounded stream encrypters/decrypters (64KB chunks), Argon2id key derivation worker threads, zeroize memory hygiene, and DOD 3-pass file shredding handlers
system_architecture.frontend_react_view: CustomTkinter-powered CustomTkinter Application with Zustand state management, interactive dropzone file tree, passphrase entropy indicator, shredding toggle panel, and dynamic MB/s throughput charts
system_architecture.ipc_communication: Sub-millisecond typed JSON channels passing commands ('create_vault', 'unlock_vault', 'shred_files') and streaming atomic 'vault-progress' payloads
system_architecture.process_safety: Thread-safe event queue passing, clean process tree termination, and memory safety
system_architecture.ui_thread: CustomTkinter main loop polling queue.Queue every 40ms for 60 FPS UI responsiveness
system_architecture.worker_threads: Background Python threads executing non-blocking stream & engine tasks

ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Systems & Security Software Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade native Windows desktop application titled 'Folder Encrypter & Vault Archiver Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-cloud, military-grade cryptographic vault suite using CustomTkinter (Python 3.10+ backend + CustomTkinter dark UI) that packs and encrypts folders into single-file zero-knowledge vaults using Argon2id key derivation, hardware-accelerated AES-256-GCM, header obfuscation, chunked memory-bounded streaming, optional source file shredding, and sub-millisecond IPC telemetry.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. PYTHON & CUSTOMTKINTER DESKTOP ARCHITECTURE:
   - Frontend built with CustomTkinter, TypeScript, CustomTkinter Styling, and Lucide CustomTkinter icons operating with sub-100ms Fast Application Startup during development.
   - Python 3.10+ backend leveraging tokio async runtime, argon2, aes-gcm, and zeroize crates for memory-safe cryptographic pipeline execution.

2. DISTINCT THEME (CYBER VAULT & NEON AMETHYST):
   - Implement a dark security workspace using #06070B (Primary Dark), #0E1017 (Panels), #161924 (Cards), #A855F7 (Amethyst Primary Accent), and #06B6D4 (Cyan Secondary Accent).
   - Provide an interactive layout featuring a drag-and-drop vault builder, passphrase strength meter, header obfuscation toggles, multi-pass file shredding inspector, and collapsible activity console.

3. CRYPTOGRAPHIC VAULT ENGINE & ZERO-KNOWLEDGE SAFETY:
   - Derive 256-bit keys using Argon2id (memory-hard KDF) with configurable cost factors.
   - Encrypt streaming 64KB data chunks via AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.
   - Enforce zero-knowledge memory safety using Zeroize on all passphrase buffers and key bytes immediately after KDF execution.

4. HEADER OBFUSCATION & MULTI-PASS FILE SHREDDER:
   - Implement header obfuscation prepending pseudo-random bytes to mask file signatures.
   - Provide an optional post-archiving source file shredder executing DoD 5220.22-M 3-pass overwrite sweeps before deleting filesystem records.

5. TELEMETRY & PROGRESS STREAMING:
   - Stream atomic progress events (vault-progress), MB/s throughput speedometers, processed byte counters, and ETA to the CustomTkinter UI via event_queue.put(...) without UI thread blocking.
